summary: Four files use removed lodash 3 helpers (_.pluck, _.where, _.findWhere, _.pairs). src/keep.js already uses lodash/map and must stay correct. A string mention of lodash must not be selected.
breakingChanges: lodash 4.0.0 removed several helpers. _.pluck(collection, property) is _.map(collection, property). _.where(collection, props) is _.filter(collection, props). _.findWhere(collection, props) is _.find(collection, props). _.pairs(object) is _.toPairs(object).
